A database of research on populism, built for literature reviews. Filter it by approach to populism and by topic. Every entry links to its DOI or to an open-access copy.

::: {.pv-periodical-body}
## PopuliVerse Monitor

A monthly digest of what populist actors did around the world: the month in brief, six regions and a list of new research publications related to populism. It describes what happened. It does not analyse. Every item links to its sources.

::: {#latest-monitor}
:::

::: {.pv-regions}

::: {.pv-label}
Around the World
:::

- Europe
- North America
- Latin America
- Asia-Pacific
- Middle East and North Africa
- Sub-Saharan Africa

:::

[All issues of the Monitor](monitor/index.qmd)
:::
